$⇒ y = 2$

Hence, the pair of lines are tangent to the parabola.

$= 2{\left(\dfrac{{y}^{3}}{6} - {y}^{2} + 2y\right)}_{0}^{2}$

$= 2\left(\dfrac{8}{6}\right) = \dfrac{8}{3}$

$∴ 3k = 8$
